description: Howard Liu re-engages RoboRide regional fleet operations with a specific vendor proposal now that RoboRide has announced residential expansion and a delivery partnership in Millfield. Howard references his prior letter of interest (tick 4) and follow-up call (tick 5), then pivots to the new context: RoboRide's expanded footprint means more vehicles operating in the zip codes Howard can serve with next-day local delivery. Howard delivers a one-page capabilities summary listing current inventory — brake consumables, filters, lubricants, sensors — with unit pricing and availability. His explicit pitch: local sourcing means faster turnaround than national distributors, which directly reduces fleet downtime. He requests a meeting with their fleet maintenance supervisor or a trial order to prove reliability.
expected_outcome: Initiation of a vendor relationship conversation with RoboRide fleet ops; best case a trial order of brake consumables or lubricants within 1-2 ticks; minimum outcome is moving from cold to warm contact with a named fleet supervisor.

economic_effects.notes: No cash changes this tick. If trial order is agreed, Howard will allocate $200-400 in existing inventory at cost to fulfill. Revenue from a fleet account relationship estimated at $800-2,000/month if converted — which would materially close the monthly deficit.

secondary_interactions.description: Howard follows up with Carlos Ruiz to confirm the EV parts inquiry from tick 7 has converted to an actual order. Howard confirms the specific SKUs stocked (EV brake fluid, ADAS sensor equivalent, or high-voltage safety consumable identified by Carlos) and asks about Sarah Kim's hybrid parts needs as a second channel in the same shop. Estimated transaction value $150 cost / $200+ revenue.

Howard calls Angela Wright directly to identify one displaced auto worker with parts counter or service advisor experience for 10-15 hours per week of part-time floor work. Howard frames the call as a mutual problem-solving conversation, not a referral request. No cash changes this tick — outcome is either a candidate identified or a commitment to follow up next tick.
